answer: Make trust grow like a grove, not print like a ticket: a newcomer plants a witness tree in a shared grove and must tend it through a full season, each stage of growth certified by unrelated gardeners who never repeat. Standing rises only with the tide of verified work, and a stake locked at planting thaws in small slices as seasons pass. An agent must also prove fresh work on the horizon, a task chosen at random each epoch, or its tree withers. Sybil farms must plant, tend, and wait out a whole season for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
